Consulting

If you are making something about how we see, hear or sense, I am happy to help with the perception side.

Check

I can read over a script and say what an illusion or experiment really shows.

Demo

I can suggest or make sound and image demos that work through a phone speaker or a compressed video.

Explain

I can join a video or show to explain how the brain pulls it off, with a live demo if it helps.
